title: I Am a Player
subtitle: Simple present and self-introduction for gamers
description: Learn how to introduce yourself in a game lobby — your username, platform, playstyle, and favourite game — using simple present.
heroImagePrompt: Two young gamers meeting for the first time in a game lobby, character selection screen glowing behind them, one waving hello, warm welcoming atmosphere, cinematic wide shot, dramatic blue and purple lighting
imageStyle: photorealistic cinematic still, movie trailer aesthetic, dramatic moody lighting, shallow depth of field, film grain texture, highly realistic people, high production value, widescreen composition, not stock photography

avatars.Alex: Close-up portrait headshot of a young male gamer named Alex, late teens, friendly confident smile, wearing a gaming headset around his neck, dark gaming room background with subtle RGB lighting
avatars.Kai: Close-up portrait headshot of a young male gamer named Kai, mid-teens, bright enthusiastic expression, hoodie, dark gaming room background with subtle screen glow, excited new-player energy

grammarFocus.focusTitle: Focus: Simple Present — I am / I play / I like
grammarFocus.description: Use simple present to talk about facts, habits, and things that are always true — like who you are and how you play.

vocabulary.definition: The name you choose for your account in a game.
vocabulary.example: My username is DragonSlayer99. What is your username?
vocabulary.imagePrompt: Cinematic close-up of a game profile screen showing a glowing username being typed letter by letter, dramatic blue interface light, dark background, shallow depth of field

vocabulary.definition: A title or number that shows how skilled you are.
vocabulary.example: I am Silver rank. I want to reach Gold next season.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A glowing silver rank badge on a game screen surrounded by dramatic metallic light, dark background, other rank badges visible but dimmer, cinematic close-up

vocabulary.definition: The character you play most often.
vocabulary.example: My main is the warrior. I play him in every match.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A single character portrait glowing brightly on a game selection screen, all other characters slightly dimmed, a hand pointing at it with pride, dramatic choice moment, cinematic shot

vocabulary.example: I usually play solo because my friends are offline.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A lone gamer sitting in a dark room with a single glowing screen, empty chairs around them, moody blue atmospheric light, cinematic solitary atmosphere

vocabulary.definition: A group of players who play together as a team.
vocabulary.example: I play with my squad every weekend. We are four players.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: Four gamers at separate setups all connected on the same match, each screen showing the same game, team energy, dramatic lighting, cinematic wide shot

vocabulary.definition: The device you use to play — PC, console, or mobile.
vocabulary.example: I play on PC. What is your platform?
vocabulary.imagePrompt: Three gaming devices side by side — a glowing PC monitor, a console with controller, and a smartphone — dramatically lit against a dark background, cinematic product shot

vocabulary.definition: Playing for fun, not to compete seriously.
vocabulary.example: I am a casual player. I play to relax after school.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A teenager lying on a couch with a controller, smiling and relaxed, warm soft lighting, no stress, cinematic chill gaming atmosphere, comfortable home environment

vocabulary.definition: Playing seriously to win and improve your rank.
vocabulary.example: He is a competitive player. He practises for two hours every day.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: An intense focused gamer leaning close to the screen, hands gripping the mouse tightly, ranked match visible on screen, dramatic sharp lighting, serious determined expression, cinematic tension

vocabulary.definition: The one you like the most.
vocabulary.example: My favourite game is this one. I play it every day.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A gamer pointing excitedly at a game on screen with a huge smile, golden warm lighting, triumphant moment of pure enthusiasm, cinematic wide shot

vocabulary.definition: The amount of time you have spent playing a game.
vocabulary.example: I have 500 hours in this game. I know every map.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A game stats screen showing 500 hours played in large glowing numbers, dark cinematic environment, dramatic close-up, sense of dedication and time invested

vocabulary.definition: The part of the world where your game server is.
vocabulary.example: I play in the Asia region. My connection is very good.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A world map on a game server selection screen, one region glowing and highlighted while others are dim, dramatic blue cartographic lighting, cinematic close-up

vocabulary.definition: The waiting room where players meet before a match.
vocabulary.example: I am in the lobby. The match starts in 30 seconds.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A game pre-match lobby screen glowing with player names, avatars, and a countdown timer, dramatic anticipation energy, cinematic wide shot of screen in dark room

phrasalVerbs.definition: Use this to introduce yourself — say your username or real name.
phrasalVerbs.example: Hi! My name is Kai. Nice to meet you!
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: Two gamers meeting for the first time in a game lobby, one waving to introduce themselves, warm friendly lighting, handshake energy, cinematic dramatic shot

phrasalVerbs.definition: Use this to say which platform or game you play.
phrasalVerbs.example: I play on PC. Do you play on console or mobile?
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: A gamer gesturing proudly toward their gaming PC setup, dramatic side lighting, dark background, sense of pride in their platform, cinematic wide angle shot

phrasalVerbs.definition: Use this to say which game or character you play most often.
phrasalVerbs.example: I mainly play battle royale. I love the last-player-standing format.
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: A player watching their favourite character on screen doing a victory pose, looking with pride and loyalty, dramatic lighting, cinematic medium shot

phrasalVerbs.definition: A polite phrase to say when you meet someone for the first time.
phrasalVerbs.example: Nice to meet you! Do you want to play together sometime?
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: Two gamers giving each other a thumbs up through their screens, warm friendly lighting, connection across distance, cinematic shot

phrasalVerbs.definition: Use this to say you play for fun and don't take rank seriously.
phrasalVerbs.example: I am a casual player. I don't worry about my rank — just fun!
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: Relaxed gamer laughing at the screen, leaning back in chair, no tension or stress, bright warm room, casual happy atmosphere, cinematic wide shot

phrasalVerbs.phrase: how long have you been playing
phrasalVerbs.definition: Ask this to find out how much experience someone has.
phrasalVerbs.example: How long have you been playing? I started two months ago.
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: Two gamers in friendly conversation, one holding up two fingers to show months, discussion about gaming experience, cinematic dramatic lighting

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Hey! Welcome to the [[lobby:the waiting area before a match]]. What's your [[username:the name you choose for your account]]?

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.text: Hi! My name is Kai — username KaiStorm22. Nice to meet you! Are you [[casual:playing for fun]] or [[competitive:playing seriously to win]]?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Mostly casual, but I play ranked sometimes. What's your [[rank:a title showing how skilled you are]]?

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.text: I'm Bronze. I'm new — only 50 [[hours:time spent playing]] so far. What [[platform:the device you play on]] are you on?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: PC. I mainly play in the Asia [[region:the part of the world where your server is]].

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.text: Same! PC, Asia region. Do you play [[solo:alone, without a team]] or with a [[squad:a group who play together]]?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Both! Solo in the morning, squad on weekends. Who is your [[main:the character you play most]]?

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.text: The ranger. She is my [[favourite:the one I like the most]] — fast and good from long range. Want to play together?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: For sure! The match starts in 30 seconds. Good luck, Kai!

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.text: You too! Let's win this one!
